picks.headline: v0 now reads npm credentials from shared environment variables
picks.excerpt: v0 can now install private packages from npm and custom registries, letting teams generate UI against their own internal design system packages instead of generic components.
picks.rationale: v0 can now pull a team's private design system package, so generated UI matches the real component library from the first prompt.

picks.headline: Figma Motion basics: Use shaders in your animations
picks.excerpt: Figma walks through applying generative shaders inside Figma Motion, showing how prompt-generated visual effects become reusable animation layers in a design file.
picks.rationale: First-party walkthrough of prompt-generated shaders as reusable Motion layers — a technique a designer can apply in Figma the same day.

picks.headline: Artec Neo: the first 'tolerance-driven' 3D scanner launched
picks.excerpt: Artec Neo promises to change quality inspection and reverse engineering for design teams with high-resolution, full-colour 3D capture tied to stated tolerances.
picks.rationale: New hardware that ties scan capture to stated tolerances, moving reverse engineering and inspection into the industrial designer's own loop.

picks.headline: Quad Remesher for Hard-Surface & Organic Blender Models
picks.excerpt: A user-friendly automatic retopology add-on from Milad Kambari that cuts polygon counts on both hard-surface and organic Blender models without manual cleanup.
picks.rationale: Free automatic retopology that removes the manual cleanup step between a generated or scanned mesh and a usable production model.

picks.headline: The next phase of design will still be human-led
picks.excerpt: Generative AI turns ideas into artefacts faster than ever, which Spotify's senior director of product design argues makes human judgement more important, not less: 'More is not always better. Faster is not always better.'
picks.rationale: Spotify's design lead sets out where judgement has to sit once generation is cheap — a concrete stance for teams rewriting their critique process.
